price_method: For each unique LCSC code, aggregate the populated quantity per board times 100; select the official JLCPCB public prices interval covering that exact quantity. Apply that unit price to every matching designator. No attrition purchases included.
stock_method: Use canPresaleNumber when supplied, otherwise overseasStockCount. Stock is not reserved; compare against aggregate requirement.
